title: Ledger
description: The line items behind a figure: pick a month or period and filters, or arrive by clicking a figure on another dashboard.

list.name: month
list.label: Month
list.description: The month shown, or the month the period is counted from.
list.query: select to_char(month_start, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as __value, to_char(month_start, 'Mon YYYY') as __text from marts.fct_month_plan order by month_start desc
list.definition: select to_char(month_start, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as __value, to_char(month_start, 'Mon YYYY') as __text from marts.fct_month_plan order by month_start desc

list.name: span
list.label: Period
list.description: Which months to show, counted from the month on the left. Custom dates uses the From and To boxes.
list.query: This month : 0,The 3 full months before it : 3,The 6 full months before it : 6,The 12 full months before it : 12,The 12 months ending with it : r12,Its calendar year : year,Everything : all,Custom dates : custom

list.name: from
list.label: From
list.description: First day, as YYYY-MM-DD. Used only when Period is Custom dates.

list.name: to
list.label: To
list.description: Last day, as YYYY-MM-DD. Used only when Period is Custom dates.

list.name: category

list.definition: select v as __value, t as __text from (select 'all' as v, 'All' as t, 0 as o union all select distinct category_name, category_name, 1 from marts.fct_subcategory_month) x order by o, t

panels.title: This selection
panels.description: Totals for the selection. Per month divides by the calendar months the period touches, counting only months the ledger covers.

targets.rawSql:
select coalesce(sum(f.amount), 0) as "Spent", coalesce(sum(f.amount), 0) / max(r.n) as "Per month", count(f.line_key) as "Line items"
from (
  select d0, d1, lo, cur,
    (extract(year from age(date_trunc('month', d1 - 1), date_trunc('month', d0))) * 12
      + extract(month from age(date_trunc('month', d1 - 1), date_trunc('month', d0))) + 1)::int as n
  from (
    select greatest(a, lo) as d0, greatest(least(b, hi), greatest(a, lo) + 1) as d1, lo, cur
    from (
      select m.lo, m.hi, m.cur,
        case '${span}'
          when '0' then s.m
          when '3' then (s.m - interval '3 months')::date
          when '6' then (s.m - interval '6 months')::date
          when '12' then (s.m - interval '12 months')::date
          when 'r12' then (s.m - interval '11 months')::date
          when 'year' then date_trunc('year', s.m)::date
          when 'custom' then case when ${from:sqlstring} ~ '^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$' then to_date(${from:sqlstring}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') else m.lo end
          else m.lo
        end as a,
        case '${span}'
          when '0' then (s.m + interval '1 month')::date
          when '3' then s.m
          when '6' then s.m
          when '12' then s.m
          when 'r12' then (s.m + interval '1 month')::date
          when 'year' then (date_trunc('year', s.m) + interval '1 year')::date
          when 'custom' then case when ${to:sqlstring} ~ '^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$' then to_date(${to:sqlstring}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1 else m.hi end
          else m.hi
        end as b
      from (select to_date('${month}', 'YYYY-MM-DD') as m) s
      cross join (
        select min(month_start) as lo, (max(month_start) + interval '1 month')::date as hi,
               max(month_start) filter (where not is_complete_month) as cur
        from marts.fct_month_plan
      ) m
    ) x
  ) y
) r
left join marts.fct_transactions f
  on f.type = 'expense'
  and f.occurred_on >= r.d0 and f.occurred_on < r.d1
  and ('${bucket}' = 'all' or initcap(f.bucket) = '${bucket}')
  and (${category:sqlstring} = 'all' or f.category_name = ${category:sqlstring})
  and ('${paid}' = 'all' or f.is_self_funded = ('${paid}' = 'own'))
  and (${tag:sqlstring} = 'all' or ${tag:sqlstring} = any(f.tags))
  and (${merchant:sqlstring} = 'all' or f.merchant_name = ${merchant:sqlstring})
  and (${channel:sqlstring} = 'all' or coalesce(f.channel_name, 'Bought directly') = ${channel:sqlstring})
  and (${q:sqlstring} = '' or concat_ws(' ', f.item_description, f.description, f.merchant_name, f.venue_name, f.notes, f.item_note) ilike '%' || ${q:sqlstring} || '%')

panels.title: By category
panels.description: Each category in the selection, largest first. Share is its part of the selection. Change compares Per month with the mean of the 3 full months before the period; it stays empty when the period includes the unfinished month, is not whole months, or the ledger does not reach 3 months further back.

targets.rawSql:
with r as (select * from (
  select d0, d1, lo, cur,
    (extract(year from age(date_trunc('month', d1 - 1), date_trunc('month', d0))) * 12
      + extract(month from age(date_trunc('month', d1 - 1), date_trunc('month', d0))) + 1)::int as n
  from (
    select greatest(a, lo) as d0, greatest(least(b, hi), greatest(a, lo) + 1) as d1, lo, cur
    from (
      select m.lo, m.hi, m.cur,
        case '${span}'
          when '0' then s.m
          when '3' then (s.m - interval '3 months')::date
          when '6' then (s.m - interval '6 months')::date
          when '12' then (s.m - interval '12 months')::date
          when 'r12' then (s.m - interval '11 months')::date
          when 'year' then date_trunc('year', s.m)::date
          when 'custom' then case when ${from:sqlstring} ~ '^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$' then to_date(${from:sqlstring}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') else m.lo end
          else m.lo
        end as a,
        case '${span}'
          when '0' then (s.m + interval '1 month')::date
          when '3' then s.m
          when '6' then s.m
          when '12' then s.m
          when 'r12' then (s.m + interval '1 month')::date
          when 'year' then (date_trunc('year', s.m) + interval '1 year')::date
          when 'custom' then case when ${to:sqlstring} ~ '^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$' then to_date(${to:sqlstring}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1 else m.hi end
          else m.hi
        end as b
      from (select to_date('${month}', 'YYYY-MM-DD') as m) s
      cross join (
        select min(month_start) as lo, (max(month_start) + interval '1 month')::date as hi,
               max(month_start) filter (where not is_complete_month) as cur
        from marts.fct_month_plan
      ) m
    ) x
  ) y
) r0),
s as (
  select f.category_name, sum(f.amount) as spent, count(*) as line_items
  from marts.fct_transactions f cross join r
  where f.type = 'expense'
    and f.occurred_on >= r.d0 and f.occurred_on < r.d1
  and ('${bucket}' = 'all' or initcap(f.bucket) = '${bucket}')
  and (${category:sqlstring} = 'all' or f.category_name = ${category:sqlstring})
  and ('${paid}' = 'all' or f.is_self_funded = ('${paid}' = 'own'))
  and (${tag:sqlstring} = 'all' or ${tag:sqlstring} = any(f.tags))
  and (${merchant:sqlstring} = 'all' or f.merchant_name = ${merchant:sqlstring})
  and (${channel:sqlstring} = 'all' or coalesce(f.channel_name, 'Bought directly') = ${channel:sqlstring})
  and (${q:sqlstring} = '' or concat_ws(' ', f.item_description, f.description, f.merchant_name, f.venue_name, f.notes, f.item_note) ilike '%' || ${q:sqlstring} || '%')
  group by f.category_name
),
b as (
  select f.category_name, sum(f.amount) / 3 as per_month
  from marts.fct_transactions f cross join r
  where f.type = 'expense'
    and f.occurred_on >= r.d0 - interval '3 months' and f.occurred_on < r.d0
  and ('${bucket}' = 'all' or initcap(f.bucket) = '${bucket}')
  and (${category:sqlstring} = 'all' or f.category_name = ${category:sqlstring})
  and ('${paid}' = 'all' or f.is_self_funded = ('${paid}' = 'own'))
  and (${tag:sqlstring} = 'all' or ${tag:sqlstring} = any(f.tags))
  and (${merchant:sqlstring} = 'all' or f.merchant_name = ${merchant:sqlstring})
  and (${channel:sqlstring} = 'all' or coalesce(f.channel_name, 'Bought directly') = ${channel:sqlstring})
  and (${q:sqlstring} = '' or concat_ws(' ', f.item_description, f.description, f.merchant_name, f.venue_name, f.notes, f.item_note) ilike '%' || ${q:sqlstring} || '%')
  group by f.category_name
)
select
  s.category_name as "Category",
  s.spent as "Spent",
  s.spent / r.n as "Per month",
  s.line_items as "Line items",
  s.spent / sum(s.spent) over () as "Share",
  case when r.d0 = date_trunc('month', r.d0) and r.d1 = date_trunc('month', r.d1)
        and r.d1 <= coalesce(r.cur, r.d1) and r.d0 - interval '3 months' >= r.lo
       then case when (s.spent / r.n - coalesce(b.per_month, 0)) > 0 then '+$' when (s.spent / r.n - coalesce(b.per_month, 0)) < 0 then '−$' else '$' end || to_char(abs(round((s.spent / r.n - coalesce(b.per_month, 0)))), 'FM999999990') end as "Change"
from s cross join r
left join b on b.category_name = s.category_name
order by s.spent desc, 1

panels.title: Line items
panels.description: Every line item in the selection, largest first; click a header to sort or filter. Merchant is a specific shop you track; Venue is the kind of place; Channel is the app it was bought through, empty when bought directly. Merchant and Venue can be empty.

targets.rawSql:
select
  to_char(f.occurred_on, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as "Date",
  coalesce(f.item_description, f.description) as "Item",
  f.merchant_name as "Merchant",
  f.venue_name as "Venue",
  f.channel_name as "Channel",
  f.category_name as "Category",
  f.subcategory_name as "Subcategory",
  initcap(f.bucket) as "Bucket",
  f.amount as "Amount",
  array_to_string(f.tags, ', ') as "Tags",
  f.funding_source_name as "Paid by",
  coalesce(f.item_note, f.notes) as "Note"
from marts.fct_transactions f
cross join (
  select d0, d1, lo, cur,
    (extract(year from age(date_trunc('month', d1 - 1), date_trunc('month', d0))) * 12
      + extract(month from age(date_trunc('month', d1 - 1), date_trunc('month', d0))) + 1)::int as n
  from (
    select greatest(a, lo) as d0, greatest(least(b, hi), greatest(a, lo) + 1) as d1, lo, cur
    from (
      select m.lo, m.hi, m.cur,
        case '${span}'
          when '0' then s.m
          when '3' then (s.m - interval '3 months')::date
          when '6' then (s.m - interval '6 months')::date
          when '12' then (s.m - interval '12 months')::date
          when 'r12' then (s.m - interval '11 months')::date
          when 'year' then date_trunc('year', s.m)::date
          when 'custom' then case when ${from:sqlstring} ~ '^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$' then to_date(${from:sqlstring}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') else m.lo end
          else m.lo
        end as a,
        case '${span}'
          when '0' then (s.m + interval '1 month')::date
          when '3' then s.m
          when '6' then s.m
          when '12' then s.m
          when 'r12' then (s.m + interval '1 month')::date
          when 'year' then (date_trunc('year', s.m) + interval '1 year')::date
          when 'custom' then case when ${to:sqlstring} ~ '^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$' then to_date(${to:sqlstring}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1 else m.hi end
          else m.hi
        end as b
      from (select to_date('${month}', 'YYYY-MM-DD') as m) s
      cross join (
        select min(month_start) as lo, (max(month_start) + interval '1 month')::date as hi,
               max(month_start) filter (where not is_complete_month) as cur
        from marts.fct_month_plan
      ) m
    ) x
  ) y
) r
where f.type = 'expense'
  and f.occurred_on >= r.d0 and f.occurred_on < r.d1
  and ('${bucket}' = 'all' or initcap(f.bucket) = '${bucket}')
  and (${category:sqlstring} = 'all' or f.category_name = ${category:sqlstring})

  and (${tag:sqlstring} = 'all' or ${tag:sqlstring} = any(f.tags))
  and (${merchant:sqlstring} = 'all' or f.merchant_name = ${merchant:sqlstring})

  and (${q:sqlstring} = '' or concat_ws(' ', f.item_description, f.description, f.merchant_name, f.venue_name, f.notes, f.item_note) ilike '%' || ${q:sqlstring} || '%')
order by f.amount desc, f.occurred_on desc, f.line_key

panels.title: Selection by month
panels.description: Spending that matches the filters at the top for each of the last 12 full months and this month, whatever period is selected. It shows whether a figure is a one-off or a habit. * marks this month so far.

targets.rawSql:
select
  to_char(p.month_start, 'Mon YY') || case when p.is_complete_month then '' else '*' end as month,
  coalesce(sum(f.amount), 0) as "Spent"
from (select * from marts.fct_month_plan order by month_start desc limit 13) p
left join marts.fct_transactions f
  on f.month_start = p.month_start
  and f.type = 'expense'
  and ('${bucket}' = 'all' or initcap(f.bucket) = '${bucket}')
  and (${category:sqlstring} = 'all' or f.category_name = ${category:sqlstring})
  and ('${paid}' = 'all' or f.is_self_funded = ('${paid}' = 'own'))
  and (${tag:sqlstring} = 'all' or ${tag:sqlstring} = any(f.tags))
  and (${merchant:sqlstring} = 'all' or f.merchant_name = ${merchant:sqlstring})
  and (${channel:sqlstring} = 'all' or coalesce(f.channel_name, 'Bought directly') = ${channel:sqlstring})
  and (${q:sqlstring} = '' or concat_ws(' ', f.item_description, f.description, f.merchant_name, f.venue_name, f.notes, f.item_note) ilike '%' || ${q:sqlstring} || '%')
group by p.month_start, p.is_complete_month
order by p.month_start

panels.title: Selection by merchant

  from marts.fct_transactions f
  cross join (
    select d0, d1, lo, cur,
      (extract(year from age(date_trunc('month', d1 - 1), date_trunc('month', d0))) * 12
        + extract(month from age(date_trunc('month', d1 - 1), date_trunc('month', d0))) + 1)::int as n
    from (
      select greatest(a, lo) as d0, greatest(least(b, hi), greatest(a, lo) + 1) as d1, lo, cur
      from (
        select m.lo, m.hi, m.cur,
          case '${span}'
            when '0' then s.m
            when '3' then (s.m - interval '3 months')::date
            when '6' then (s.m - interval '6 months')::date
            when '12' then (s.m - interval '12 months')::date
            when 'r12' then (s.m - interval '11 months')::date
            when 'year' then date_trunc('year', s.m)::date
            when 'custom' then case when ${from:sqlstring} ~ '^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$' then to_date(${from:sqlstring}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') else m.lo end
            else m.lo
          end as a,
          case '${span}'
            when '0' then (s.m + interval '1 month')::date
            when '3' then s.m
            when '6' then s.m
            when '12' then s.m
            when 'r12' then (s.m + interval '1 month')::date
            when 'year' then (date_trunc('year', s.m) + interval '1 year')::date
            when 'custom' then case when ${to:sqlstring} ~ '^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$' then to_date(${to:sqlstring}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1 else m.hi end
            else m.hi
          end as b
        from (select to_date('${month}', 'YYYY-MM-DD') as m) s
        cross join (
          select min(month_start) as lo, (max(month_start) + interval '1 month')::date as hi,
                 max(month_start) filter (where not is_complete_month) as cur
          from marts.fct_month_plan
        ) m
      ) x
    ) y
  ) r
  where f.type = 'expense'
    and f.occurred_on >= r.d0 and f.occurred_on < r.d1
    and ('${bucket}' = 'all' or initcap(f.bucket) = '${bucket}')

) x
order by ("Merchant" = 'No merchant recorded'), "Spent" desc, 1
limit 9

panels.title: Selection by venue
panels.description: The selection by kind of place, largest first. The last row gathers everything logged without a venue.

targets.rawSql:

  select coalesce(f.venue_name, 'No venue recorded') as "Venue", sum(f.amount) as "Spent", count(distinct f.transaction_id) as "Purchases"
  from marts.fct_transactions f
  cross join (
    select d0, d1, lo, cur,
      (extract(year from age(date_trunc('month', d1 - 1), date_trunc('month', d0))) * 12
        + extract(month from age(date_trunc('month', d1 - 1), date_trunc('month', d0))) + 1)::int as n
    from (
      select greatest(a, lo) as d0, greatest(least(b, hi), greatest(a, lo) + 1) as d1, lo, cur
      from (
        select m.lo, m.hi, m.cur,
          case '${span}'
            when '0' then s.m
            when '3' then (s.m - interval '3 months')::date
            when '6' then (s.m - interval '6 months')::date
            when '12' then (s.m - interval '12 months')::date
            when 'r12' then (s.m - interval '11 months')::date
            when 'year' then date_trunc('year', s.m)::date
            when 'custom' then case when ${from:sqlstring} ~ '^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$' then to_date(${from:sqlstring}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') else m.lo end
            else m.lo
          end as a,

            when '3' then s.m
            when '6' then s.m
            when '12' then s.m

            else m.hi
          end as b
        from (select to_date('${month}', 'YYYY-MM-DD') as m) s
        cross join (
          select min(month_start) as lo, (max(month_start) + interval '1 month')::date as hi,
                 max(month_start) filter (where not is_complete_month) as cur
          from marts.fct_month_plan
        ) m

  ) r
  where f.type = 'expense'
    and f.occurred_on >= r.d0 and f.occurred_on < r.d1
    and ('${bucket}' = 'all' or initcap(f.bucket) = '${bucket}')
    and (${category:sqlstring} = 'all' or f.category_name = ${category:sqlstring})
    and ('${paid}' = 'all' or f.is_self_funded = ('${paid}' = 'own'))
    and (${tag:sqlstring} = 'all' or ${tag:sqlstring} = any(f.tags))

    and (${channel:sqlstring} = 'all' or coalesce(f.channel_name, 'Bought directly') = ${channel:sqlstring})
    and (${q:sqlstring} = '' or concat_ws(' ', f.item_description, f.description, f.merchant_name, f.venue_name, f.notes, f.item_note) ilike '%' || ${q:sqlstring} || '%')
  group by 1
) x
order by ("Venue" = 'No venue recorded'), "Spent" desc, 1
limit 9

panels.title: Income and transfers
panels.description: Money in, and moves between your accounts, for the month or period at the top. The other filters do not apply here.

targets.rawSql:
select
  to_char(f.occurred_on, 'YYYY-MM-DD') as "Date",
  initcap(f.type) as "Type",
  f.counterparty as "From or to",
  f.amount as "Amount"
from marts.fct_ledger_entry f
cross join (
  select d0, d1, lo, cur,
    (extract(year from age(date_trunc('month', d1 - 1), date_trunc('month', d0))) * 12
      + extract(month from age(date_trunc('month', d1 - 1), date_trunc('month', d0))) + 1)::int as n
  from (
    select greatest(a, lo) as d0, greatest(least(b, hi), greatest(a, lo) + 1) as d1, lo, cur
    from (
      select m.lo, m.hi, m.cur,
        case '${span}'
          when '0' then s.m
          when '3' then (s.m - interval '3 months')::date
          when '6' then (s.m - interval '6 months')::date
          when '12' then (s.m - interval '12 months')::date
          when 'r12' then (s.m - interval '11 months')::date
          when 'year' then date_trunc('year', s.m)::date
          when 'custom' then case when ${from:sqlstring} ~ '^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$' then to_date(${from:sqlstring}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') else m.lo end
          else m.lo
        end as a,
        case '${span}'
          when '0' then (s.m + interval '1 month')::date
          when '3' then s.m
          when '6' then s.m
          when '12' then s.m
          when 'r12' then (s.m + interval '1 month')::date
          when 'year' then (date_trunc('year', s.m) + interval '1 year')::date
          when 'custom' then case when ${to:sqlstring} ~ '^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$' then to_date(${to:sqlstring}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') + 1 else m.hi end
          else m.hi
        end as b
      from (select to_date('${month}', 'YYYY-MM-DD') as m) s
      cross join (
        select min(month_start) as lo, (max(month_start) + interval '1 month')::date as hi,
               max(month_start) filter (where not is_complete_month) as cur
        from marts.fct_month_plan

) r
where f.type in ('income', 'transfer')
  and f.occurred_on >= r.d0 and f.occurred_on < r.d1
order by f.occurred_on desc, f.transaction_id
